content.short: SimpleHash is a multi-chain token and NFT data API providing real-time on-chain data normalized across dozens of blockchains including Mantle.
content.description: SimpleHash is a developer-focused API platform providing fast, reliable access to token and NFT data across dozens of blockchain networks, with all data normalized into a consistent schema regardless of the source chain. APIs cover token metadata, ownership data, transfer history, floor prices, and sale events. Integrated with Mantle Network, SimpleHash makes it straightforward for developers to build NFT-focused and token-focused applications on Mantle.
content.meta: SimpleHash provides multi-chain token and NFT data APIs for developers building on Mantle. Discover SimpleHash on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
